scope: Five existing UK directory records refreshed; two research/learning sources added. Official websites checked; no institution has registered or endorsed IDEBP by being listed.

sources.name: Crime Reduction Toolkit
sources.about: Find summaries of crime reduction interventions, with links to systematic reviews and information about implementation, costs and settings where interventions were studied.

brand.evidence: No logo or brand imitation: use normal directory typography.

sources.logoNotes: The College explicitly limits use of its logo as a link to its website. Hypertext links are permitted. No logo included pending permission.
reviewNotes: Official indexed pages support the summary; direct website fetch returned HTTP 403. Source methods refer to the collection, not appraisal of every item.

sources.name: Society of Evidence Based Policing
sources.about: Find research briefings, articles, events and member resources from the independent UK society connecting police practitioners, researchers and evidence-based policing networks.

brand.evidence: Colours observed in the organisation’s original businessLogo asset; not a published brand guideline.

sources.logoNotes: Use original square wordmark on white. Official site favicon is a different dated illustration and was deliberately excluded.
reviewNotes: Official homepage describes SEBP as an independent registered UK charity. These links are found on the official site, not evidence of registration with IDEBP.

sources.name: Practice Bank
sources.about: Browse accounts of policing and community safety interventions, including implementation details, local learning and available evaluation information from participating organisations.

brand.evidence: No logo or brand imitation: use normal directory typography.

sources.logoNotes: The College explicitly limits use of its logo as a link to its website. Hypertext links are permitted. No logo included pending permission.
reviewNotes: Removed blanket Process evaluation classification: entries have different evaluation arrangements, including new/innovative practice. Direct website fetch returned HTTP 403; official indexed description verified.

sources.name: Youth Endowment Fund Toolkit
sources.about: Explore research summaries on preventing violence involving children and young people, with information about evidence, costs and implementation across policing and other services.

brand.evidence: Exact colour values present in official logo SVG and main website stylesheet.

sources.logoNotes: Original SVG, static paths only; no scripts, event handlers, embedded foreign content or external references. Preserve full logo.
reviewNotes: Added Welsh: the official Welsh toolkit contains translated intervention titles and descriptions, not merely interface labels. Original research languages may vary; directory field describes available source content.

sources.name: Thinking About Policing
sources.about: Read articles connecting policing research, policy, leadership and operational experience, with links to original sources. Published independently by directory founder Nathan Tracey.

brand.evidence: Colour values observed in official homepage; logo remains original artwork.

sources.logoNotes: Original 512-pixel transparent mark obtained from the published site.
reviewNotes: Retain founder conflict disclosure. Primary authored content is English; automatic interface/content translation options are not treated as independently authored research languages.

sources.name: Police Science Dr
sources.owner: Raven’s Ocean Ltd / Dr Susanne Knabe-Nicol
sources.about: Find short research briefings, videos and podcasts for policing practitioners, alongside transcripts and online courses covering investigations, psychology and evidence-based practice.

brand.evidence: Approximate teal and purple sampled from the official masthead artwork; not a published brand guideline.

sources.logoNotes: Original masthead image, 1920 × 910 pixels. Preserve the black background and full mark; no artificial reconstruction.
reviewNotes: Homepage videos/podcasts are public, transcripts require free mailing-list membership; academy courses have their own terms. Company owner is stated on official privacy page. Logo provenance is verified, but no separate brand reuse permission was obtained.

sources.name: Cambridge Centre for Evidence-Based Policing
sources.owner: Cambridge Centre for Evidence-Based Policing Ltd
sources.about: Locate policing research, crime harm resources and professional training from a research and consultancy organisation working with police services internationally.

brand.evidence: Colours sampled from the original official masthead PNG; not a published brand guideline.

sources.logoNotes: Original official 490 × 116 wordmark. Suitable at up to approximately 245 CSS pixels for sharp rendering; do not enlarge as a full-width raster banner.
reviewNotes: Classified as Company and Learning provider, not the University of Cambridge. Official footer identifies a limited company; research page describes RCT and quasi-experimental evaluation. Courses and consultancy may be paid.

assetPolicy: Logos are attributed original source identifiers. No photographic banners were downloaded. College of Policing logos withheld because its official page explicitly limits this link use.
visualChecks: All five supplied official logos visually inspected at display size, including YEF SVG rendered in Chromium. YEF SVG also inspected as static vector paths with no active or external content.
